description: CLI application that runs a full content generation pipeline for children's audio series. Generates character briefs, season arcs, episode plots, scripts, and synthesizes them into audio files for podcast distribution. https://github.com/seekayel/story-time

issues.title: Project setup with Bun, TypeScript, Biome
issues.description: Initialize the project with Bun runtime, TypeScript, Biome for linting, bun test for testing. Set up package.json with scripts for lint, build, and test. Create tsconfig.json, biome.json, .gitignore, and .env.example.

issues.title: CLI framework and command routing
issues.description: Set up the CLI entry point using Commander.js. Register all pipeline commands: init, develop-show, develop-season, develop-episode, write-script, translate, synthesize, publish, config. Each command accepts the flags described in the spec (--season, --episode, --model, --show).

issues.title: Show init command
issues.description: Implement 'story-time init <show-name>' command that creates the show directory structure and a default show.yaml configuration file with the schema defined in the spec.

issues.title: Show configuration loading and validation
issues.description: Implement show.yaml parsing and validation with Zod schemas. Load show config from the active show directory. Validate required fields (name, description, setting, characters with voice_ids, content_guidelines). Support the config command for setting active show path and default model.

issues.title: LLM integration with Vercel AI SDK
issues.description: Set up Vercel AI SDK with support for Gemini 2.5 Pro (default) and Claude Sonnet 4.5. Load API keys from environment variables. Create a shared LLM helper that accepts prompts and returns structured output. Support model switching via config command.

issues.title: Stage 1: develop-show command
issues.description: Implement the develop-show command that reads show.yaml and generates character brief markdown files in characters/*.md. Should incorporate existing character files and FEEDBACK comments on re-runs.

issues.title: Stage 2: develop-season command
issues.description: Implement the develop-season command that reads characters and show config to generate seasons/season-XX/arc.md. Should incorporate existing arc file and FEEDBACK comments on re-runs.

issues.title: Stage 3: develop-episode command
issues.description: Implement the develop-episode command that reads arc and characters to generate episodes/ep-XX/plot.md. Should incorporate existing plot file and FEEDBACK comments on re-runs.

issues.title: Stage 4: write-script command
issues.description: Implement the write-script command that reads plot and characters to generate episodes/ep-XX/script.md in the structured YAML format defined in the spec. Should incorporate existing script and FEEDBACK comments on re-runs.

issues.title: Stage 5: translate command
issues.description: Implement the translate command that reads script.md and produces script-es.md (or script-{target_language}.md). Uses LLM for translation from source to target language.

issues.title: Stage 6: synthesize command with ElevenLabs
issues.description: Implement the synthesize command that reads the translated script and uses ElevenLabs API to generate audio.mp3 for each episode. Map character dialogue to voice IDs from show.yaml. Skip non-verbal actions.

issues.title: Stage 7: publish command for RSS
issues.description: Implement the publish command that posts audio files and metadata to the podcast RSS endpoint for Apple Podcasts distribution.

issues.title: Environment variable and .env loading
issues.description: Set up .env file loading via dotenv for API keys (GEMINI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ELEVEN_LABS_API_KEY, PODCAST_RSS_ENDPOINT, PODCAST_API_KEY). Created .env.example template.

issues.title: Unit tests for schemas, config, files, and init
issues.description: Maintain passing tests for Zod schemas (showConfigSchema, scriptSchema), config path helpers (getSeasonDir, getEpisodeDir), file utilities (extractFeedback), and the init command (creates directory structure, valid show.yaml, duplicate detection).

issues.title: Integration tests for CLI commands
issues.description: Integration tests for all 7 pipeline commands plus config, with mocked LLM and fetch. Tests cover: happy paths (file generation, audio synthesis, publishing), error paths (missing prerequisites, invalid inputs, missing API keys, API errors), edge cases (feedback incorporation, season/episode numbering). 43 new integration test cases across 8 test files with test fixture helpers.

issues.title: Error handling and user-friendly messages
issues.description: All commands have proper error handling: config validation, episode/season number validation, missing API key checks, missing prerequisite file checks with actionable next-step messages, graceful degradation for optional resources. Verified through integration tests.

issues.title: Batch processing support
issues.description: Run multiple episodes through the pipeline at once. All 5 episode-based commands (develop-episode, write-script, translate, synthesize, estimate-duration) accept episode ranges (1-5), comma-separated lists (1,3,5), mixed formats (1-3,7,9-11), or --all flag to process every episode in the season. Implemented via src/lib/episodes.ts (parseEpisodeRange, resolveEpisodes) for range parsing and src/lib/batch.ts (runBatch) for sequential execution with error isolation. Failed episodes are logged but don't abort the batch. CLI arguments changed from required <episode-number> to optional [episodes] with --all flag. Single-episode usage remains unchanged for backward compatibility. Unit tests in tests/episodes.test.ts and tests/batch.test.ts, integration tests in tests/commands/batch-develop-episode.test.ts.

issues.title: Duration estimation before synthesis
issues.description: Estimate episode audio duration from script dialogue word count before running expensive ElevenLabs synthesis. Implemented in src/lib/duration.ts with estimateDuration() and formatDurationEstimate() utilities. Estimates based on language-specific speech rates (130 wpm English, 140 wpm Spanish), inter-beat pauses, scene transitions, and action beat timing. New 'story-time estimate-duration <episode>' CLI command with --translated flag. Duration estimate also displayed automatically in synthesize command before API calls. Compares estimate to target duration from show.yaml. Unit tests in tests/duration.test.ts and integration tests in tests/commands/estimate-duration.test.ts.

issues.title: Narrator voice support
issues.description: Add optional narrator voice that reads scene descriptions and stage directions during audio synthesis.

issues.title: Retry logic for API calls
issues.description: Add retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures in LLM API calls (Gemini/Claude), ElevenLabs synthesis API, and podcast RSS publishing endpoint. Implemented in src/lib/retry.ts with withRetry utility and isRetryableStatusCode helper. Integrated into src/lib/llm.ts (generate function), src/commands/synthesize.ts (ElevenLabs fetch), and src/commands/publish.ts (RSS publishing fetch). Retries up to 3 times with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Only retries transient errors (408, 429, 500+), not client errors (400, 401, 403, 404).

issues.title: Validate LLM output format for scripts
issues.description: After LLM generates a script (write-script and translate commands), validate the output parses as valid YAML matching the scriptSchema. Re-prompt the LLM if validation fails (up to 3 attempts), to avoid downstream synthesis errors. Implemented in src/lib/scripts.ts with extractYaml and validateScriptYaml helpers, integrated into both write-script and translate commands. Unit tests in tests/scripts.test.ts and validation retry integration tests in tests/commands/write-script-validation.test.ts and tests/commands/translate-validation.test.ts.

issues.title: Unit tests for script validation helpers
issues.description: Maintain passing tests for extractYaml and validateScriptYaml in tests/scripts.test.ts. Tests cover: YAML extraction from markdown code blocks, valid script parsing, missing required fields, invalid YAML syntax, and edge cases.

issues.title: Integration tests for script validation retry
issues.description: Maintain passing tests for write-script and translate validation retry behavior. Tests in tests/commands/write-script-validation.test.ts and tests/commands/translate-validation.test.ts verify that commands retry LLM generation when output fails YAML validation.

issues.title: Unit tests for retry utility
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/retry.test.ts for the withRetry function and isRetryableStatusCode helper. Tests cover: success on first attempt, retry and recover, exhaust retries, onRetry callback, isRetryable predicate, maxDelayMs cap, zero retries. Status code tests cover retryable (408, 429, 500-504) and non-retryable (200, 400, 401, 403, 404) codes.

issues.title: Integration tests for API retry in synthesize and publish
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/synthesize-retry.test.ts and tests/commands/publish-retry.test.ts. Tests verify: retry on transient 500 errors with eventual success, no retry on 401/400 client errors, retry on 429 rate limits, retry on 503 with eventual graceful failure. Tests use mocked retry module with zero-delay sleep for fast execution.

issues.title: Pipeline status command
issues.description: Implement 'story-time status' command that shows pipeline progress for a show. Displays which characters have been generated, whether season arcs exist, and per-episode status of each pipeline stage (plot, script, translated, audio). Supports --show and --season flags. Includes summary counts and a suggested next command. Testable via exported getShowStatus function. Implemented in src/commands/status.ts with integration tests in tests/commands/status.test.ts.

issues.title: Integration tests for status command
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/status.test.ts. Tests cover: show name and path, empty/populated characters, season arc status, per-episode pipeline stage tracking, default season when none exist, multi-season scanning, season filtering, and error on missing show path.

issues.title: Per-command --model flag override
issues.description: Add --model flag to individual pipeline commands (develop-show, develop-season, develop-episode, write-script, translate) to override the default model for a single run without changing the global config. Implemented by adding --model option to all 5 LLM commands in CLI entry point and threading the ModelProvider through each command function's options to the generate() call. Integration tests in tests/commands/model-override.test.ts verify provider propagation for all commands and undefined when not specified.

issues.title: Sound effects library integration
issues.description: Integrate ambient sounds and sound effects into synthesized audio. Currently non-verbal actions are skipped during synthesis. Add support for mapping action descriptions to sound effect files.

issues.title: Integration tests for per-command --model flag override
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/model-override.test.ts. Tests verify that the --model flag is correctly propagated as the provider parameter to the generate() function for all 5 LLM commands (develop-show, develop-season, develop-episode, write-script, translate). Tests also verify provider is undefined when --model is not specified.

issues.title: Model flag validation
issues.description: Validate that --model flag only accepts 'gemini' or 'claude' values at all layers. Added VALID_MODELS constant and validateModelProvider() function in src/lib/llm.ts as the single source of truth. CLI layer uses Commander's choices() to reject invalid values immediately. getModel() has a runtime guard against invalid providers. loadAppConfig() validates the model value read from config.yaml on disk. Config command uses the shared validateModelProvider() instead of inline checks. Unit tests in tests/model-validation.test.ts cover valid values, invalid values, empty strings, and case-sensitive rejection.

issues.title: Unit tests for model validation
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/model-validation.test.ts. Tests cover: VALID_MODELS contains exactly gemini and claude, validateModelProvider accepts valid values and returns them, rejects invalid model names with descriptive error message, rejects empty strings, rejects case-variant names (Gemini, Claude, gpt-4).

issues.title: Unit tests for duration estimation
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/duration.test.ts. Tests cover: countWords (simple sentences, multiple spaces, empty/whitespace strings, single word, trimming), estimateDuration (empty scenes, dialogue beats, action-only beats, Spanish speech rate, unknown language fallback, scene pauses, mixed beats, minute rounding), formatDurationEstimate (without target, within/over/under target display).

issues.title: Integration tests for estimate-duration command
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/estimate-duration.test.ts. Tests cover: estimating from source script, estimating from translated script with --translated flag, target comparison output, missing script error, missing translated script error, invalid episode number, invalid YAML, invalid show path, default to source when translated is false.

issues.title: Unit tests for episode range parsing
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/episodes.test.ts. Tests cover: parseEpisodeRange (single number, range, comma-separated, mixed, deduplication, whitespace, sorting, invalid inputs, zero, negative, reversed range, empty string, invalid format) and resolveEpisodes (--all flag, smaller season, range parsing, single number, missing argument, --all precedence).

issues.title: Unit tests for batch runner
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/batch.test.ts. Tests cover: runBatch calls function for each episode in order, continues after errors, does not throw when all fail, handles single episode, handles empty list.

issues.title: Integration tests for batch develop-episode
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/batch-develop-episode.test.ts. Tests cover: processing episode range (1-3), comma-separated list (1,3,5) with verification of skipped episodes, --all resolution to full season, and error isolation (continues after individual episode failures).

issues.title: Config command test isolation
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/config.test.ts. Tests use beforeEach/afterEach to save and restore the user's ~/.story-time/config.yaml, resetting to a valid config before each test to prevent cross-test contamination from invalid model values.

issues.title: Multi-show support
issues.description: Allow managing multiple shows from one installation. Currently limited to switching --show path manually. Could add a 'story-time list-shows' command and better show discovery.

issues.title: Previous episode context for script writing
issues.description: When writing scripts or developing plots for episodes beyond episode 1, provide the LLM with summaries or scripts from previous episodes to maintain narrative continuity and avoid contradictions. Implemented in src/lib/context.ts with getPreviousEpisodeContext() and formatPreviousContext() helpers. Integrated into develop-episode (plots only) and write-script (plots + scripts) commands. develop-episode receives previous episode plots for narrative continuity; write-script receives both plots and scripts for detailed context. Unit tests in tests/context.test.ts, integration tests in tests/commands/previous-context.test.ts.

issues.title: Episode metadata and RSS feed generation
issues.description: Generate proper podcast RSS XML with episode titles, descriptions, durations, and publication dates. Implemented 'story-time generate-feed' command that scans show directories for audio files and generates feed.xml. RSS library in src/lib/rss.ts with collectEpisodeMetadata(), generateRssFeed(), escapeXml(), and formatDurationHMS() helpers. Supports feed.yaml configuration for baseUrl, author, categories, imageUrl, and email. Episodes sorted newest-first. Extracts titles from translated scripts, descriptions from plots. Supports --season filtering and --output path override. Unit tests in tests/rss.test.ts, integration tests in tests/commands/generate-feed.test.ts.

issues.title: Unit tests for previous episode context
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/context.test.ts. Tests cover: getPreviousEpisodeContext returns empty for episode 1, empty when no previous episodes exist, plot from previous episode, plot and script together, multiple previous episodes in order, skipping episodes with no files, correct season isolation. formatPreviousContext tests cover: empty summaries, plot-only context, context with scripts, exclusion of scripts when disabled, multiple episodes with separators, summary with only script.

issues.title: Integration tests for previous episode context in commands
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/previous-context.test.ts. Tests verify: episode 1 does not include previous context for both develop-episode and write-script, episode 2 includes previous episode 1 plot for develop-episode, episode 3 includes episodes 1 and 2 context, write-script includes both plots and scripts from previous episodes, narrative continuity instruction is present in prompts.

issues.title: Unit tests for RSS feed generation
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/rss.test.ts. Tests cover: escapeXml (ampersand, angle brackets, quotes, empty string, plain text), formatDurationHMS (zero, seconds, minutes, hours, padding), generateRssFeed (channel metadata, episode items, sorting newest-first, multi-season sorting, XML escaping, relative paths without baseUrl, optional fields omission, explicit flag, multiple categories, trailing slash handling, empty episodes list).

issues.title: Integration tests for generate-feed command
issues.description: Maintain passing tests in tests/commands/generate-feed.test.ts. Tests cover: generating feed.xml with audio episodes, extracting episode title from translated script, using plot description for episodes, --season filtering, including all seasons when unspecified, custom --output path, graceful handling of no audio files, working without feed.yaml (defaults), invalid show path error, XML escaping of special characters in output.
